text: The tree is right. Black's only try is Black 11 in Diagram 2. White 12 is forced: otherwise Black captures the three corner stones by playing A19, and White dies. It works: White 12 has two liberties, A14 and A16, so Black's retake at A16 is suicide.

With A14 and four nearby points added to the area, it proves White alive after White 12 and after Black's other tries, even when Black may ignore the ko ban. Only the leaf and the position after Black 11 stay undecided, a search weakness: the position after White 12 is proven in 0.1 s.
